title: Phil Woods's drunken speech and Maxwell carrying him upstairs
summary: Phil heckles his own translation, nearly fights Wayne Andre, and Maxwell carries and spanks him.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Shortly after that Alice went back to the United States. By this time, though, everyone's pretty well gone. Phil Woods stands up and says, "I'd like to make a speech." And he gets -- the alto player, Jerry Dodgion, he says, "Translate, motherfucker." So Jerry Dodgion goes (Unintelligible). So Phil goes on and he's harranguing and he says, "translate, Motherfucker." And then Phil starts talking double talk and the guy from the Embassy's trying to pull him down. And Phil says, "All right, you don't want me to talk." And everyone's looking at him, he sits down and two gallons of wine come out all over the table. And everybody's shocked and upset and they're saying, what an impression Americans are making on
on the Russians. I told them, boy, you know, anyone who drinks 32 toasts in a row has seen a drunk before. I said, don't worry about it.

So we go back to the hotel on this bus and one of the interpreters, this girl is sitting with me. And both Phil Woods and the trombone player, he used to be married to a French horn player, black girl who was a French horn player.

Wayne Andre, they're both hitting on this girl. She's sitting on my lap and there's some Georgian, I think he's a little sweet, was trying to hit on me, and it was a real complicated situation. She's sitting on my lap because there's no other room for her to sit. And David was sitting next to me.

We get to the hotel and Phil and Wayne get into an argument and Phil starts with the 'motherfucker.' And Wayne says, 'Just a minute, you son of a bitch, you can't speak like this in front of a fucking lady,' or something. In front of the Russian girl, you know. And these girls are pretty tough, they say they're KGB or whatever, you know. They're not shocked by anything. And they're going to square off and have a fight.
And this I don't think is good for the American image. So I picked Phil Woods over my shoulder, put him over my shoulder and carried him up three flights of stairs. And

he's screaming and kicking me. So I got him up in the room and I said, "Shut up, you son of a bitch." So I pulled his pants down and put him over my knee and whipped him with a hairbrush. And everyone's wondering, where is Zoot. I opened the door, here's Zoot like an angel, lying in bed. What's all the fuss, you know?
